verdict.rationale: Base44's Superagent workflows run automatically "when a trigger happens, such as activity in a connected tool." That is a first-party, event-triggered automation capability. The evidence is a single brief doc line, though: it does not show which events are supported, how rules or conditions are written, or which actions can be chained. Agents that "trigger workflows" from chat are conversational, not event-driven, so they add little here. Missing for 10: documented event types and trigger catalog, rule/condition definition syntax or UI, an action catalog for triggered workflows, app-level (not just Superagent) event triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A workflow runs on a schedule or when a trigger happens, such as activity in a connected tool.
they update records, trigger workflows, and connect to tools
